Let me think about this. The policy: full-time employees up to write, admin only if role owns system. Contractor: read or write if advanced security training, never admin.

If Jesse is full-time Payroll Specialist, admin is allowed (requested admin = max = admin). Grant admin.

If Jesse is contractor with basic training, max is read. Grant read.
